newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SGB TO CONSOLIDATE TRACTEBEL WITH EQUITY METHOD.
newsitem.headline: SGB TO CONSOLIDATE TRACTEBEL WITH EQUITY METHOD.

text.p: Belgian holding company Societe Generale de Belgique (SGB) will consolidate the earnings of its Tractebel unit according to the equity method in its 1996 accounts, SGB said on Thursday.

Etienne Davignon, chairman of the board of SGB, told Reuters in an interview that for the first nine months of 1996, SGB will consolidate 40 percent of Tractebel's net profit in its own accounts.For for the last three months it will consolidate just under 65 percent of Tractebel's earnings in proportion to the time the stock was held ("pro rata temporis").
SGB increased its Tractebel stake in September 1996, acquiring an additional 25 percent from companies linked to holding company Groupe Bruxelles Lambert SA (GBL) .
An SGB spokesman added that as of 1997, SGB may consider a full consolidation of Tractebel earnings, but that no decision had yet been taken on this.

SGB already applies full consolidation for its non-ferrous metals unit Union Miniere SA (UM) and for its polyurethane foam producing unit Recticel , in which it has stakes of 50.1 and 70 percent respectively.
Full consolidation -- whereby total profit is booked in SGB accounts despite the fact that SGB owns less than 100 percent -- of Tractebel would have a much larger impact on SGB earnings.
In 1995 UM contributed 701 million francs to SGB group current earnings, while loss-making Recticel had a negative contribution of 313 million.
Heavyweight utility holding company Tractebel contributed 3.6 billion francs.
